items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I joined Charlie Bradford ley and the Florida Collegians -- that was the name of the band.

ctx.x: So I got a letter from George Kelly, because he had broken up our band that we had; he broke up the band, so he knew that I wasn't doing anything, so he wrote me a letter and told me that Charlie Bradford ley was looking for a drummer, so I wrote him a letter right away and told him, you know, that I would like to come up there and join the band.

So they sent for me. I went to Tampa, I'll never forget it -- I landed there on the 27th of May in Tampa, 1938, and I joined Charlie Bradford ley and the Florida Collegians -- that was the name of the band. So we used to play at the Frog's Rest, which was a club there, the Frog's Rest, on Friday night and the Cuban Club in Jabo City I on Saturday. And during the week, we had, like the social clubs, we probably had 2 or 3 of those jobs a week, like; maybe Monday, Wednesday or Tuesday and Wednesday. But we always…
